regime_context: Canada/TSX detector shows a narrowing, absorbed rotation (frac 0.44, absorption 0.32) with Oil & Gas Producers as the sole dominant, crowded leader (score 1.64, durability 0.77, breadth 1.0, crowding_z 1.27) and Gold Miners as the only meaningful challenger (1.19). The absolute-trend gate is validated risk control on this history (gate_helps true), but macro_narrative is all unscheduled geopolitics/AI headlines (share 1.0) — coincident noise, not a trigger.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners (ca_gold) can lift breadth above ~0.3 and hold score above 1.0 for two consecutive weeks — that would mark a durable second narrative forming behind Oil & Gas, not a confirmed handoff. The watch retires if Gold Miners' score falls below 0.5 or breadth stays under 0.1 for a full month.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: This is the cleanly confirmed leader by both rank and rotation: highest score, full breadth (1.0), and the only theme with elevated crowding_z (1.27). The absolute-trend gate is the one validated edge here, and Oil & Gas is eligible while showing high durability_bar (0.77) — a coherent trending leader rather than a fragmented spike. This is a stay-with-trend lean, not a buy-the-leader claim.
evidence: rotation.leader id ca_oil_gas, margin 0.45 over challenger
crowded true, crowding_z 1.27 (sizing caution only, per guardrails)
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.27 plus one-narrative false and hurst 'mixed' means the trend is already widely owned and could mean-revert sharply on any oil-price headline; momentum rank has no forward edge on this universe.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO makes a 5-day total return below the S&P/TSX by 4% or more while scoring under 0.5 rank.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the only legitimate challenger in the rotation radar (score 1.19, margin to leader 0.45) and is eligible with uncrowded positioning (crowding_z 0.0). It offers trend exposure to the second narrative without the reflexivity risk of the crowded leader. Durability is lower (0.42) and breadth thin (0.067), so this is a speculative trend lean, not a confirmed handoff.
theses.dissent: Breadth 0.067 is extremely narrow — leadership rests on very few names, so it can break fast; hurst 'mixed' gives no persistence support, and macro backdrop is dominated by unscheduled geopolitics that can whipsaw precious metals either way.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO falls below its 20-day average while Gold Miners score drops under 0.6 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables is ranked 10 with a negative score (-0.285), ineligible under the absolute-trend gate, and shows negative crowding_z (-0.88) with poor breadth (0.417). The trend gate flagged it as not currently sustaining, and with gate_helps true on this market, avoiding the non-trending, out-of-favor segment is the one defensive edge worth expressing.
theses.dissent: Defensive utilities often catch a bid precisely when macro headlines turn risk-off, and the current all-unscheduled headline flow (share 1.0) makes a flight-to-safety snapback plausible; avoiding may miss that.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX by 3% or more over any 10-day window while Utilities' score rises above 0.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
